notes.title: Ver. 1.1.5
notes.content:
OK IM SO SORRY FOR THE BROKEN MOVEMENT

Fixes and changes:


 Fixed all of the movement bugs (that were found)
 Dash animation is now active underwater (wasn't a bug, just a change)
 Increased the interval between afterimages in the Level Editor (for performance)

Side note:

The slightly different movement won't affect beginner/casual players, however the muscle memory is slightly different for advanced players. 

Sorry about that, there was no other way...

notes.title: Ver. 1.0.9
notes.content:
Reasonably important update, so stay with me here.


 Removed the opening cutscene's custom name (sorry)
 Made the first playthrough of the tutorial take you to level one after beating it
 Added functionality for changing Feverish Knight's sprite (Instructions below)


To change Feverish Knight's Sprite, add a PNG to AppData/LocalLow/1actose/Knight And Mourning/ and name it "Feverish-Knight.png".

https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1079079920434679928/1152027718536405022/image.png

(to return the old sprite, just delete/rename the current image in its place and the game will re-install it for you.)

Thanks for playing!
